title: Ciorba de Burta
subtitle: Romanian sour beef soup
excerpt: Slow-cooked beef shin in a rich, soured broth finished with tempered egg yolks and soured cream. Ciorba de burta is Romania's most comforting soup and its most famous hangover cure. The sourness from vinegar and the richness from cream are perfectly balanced.
sourceNotes: Ciorba de burta is Romania's favourite hangover cure and comfort food. It is made with beef slow-cooked in a sour broth with soured cream and garlic. The sourness comes from vinegar. Traditionally tripe is used, but shin gives a similar richness.

content.text: Ciorba de burta takes the better part of an afternoon but almost all of that is unattended simmering. The tricky moment is the tempering -- adding the egg yolk and cream mixture back into the hot soup without scrambling it. Work slowly and keep the heat very low.

items.prepNote: use tripe if available -- ask your butcher -- prepared and cleaned

content.text: Place beef shin in a large pot with the halved onion, carrot, celery, and bay leaves. Pour over the stock. Bring to the boil, skim any foam.
Reduce to a gentle simmer. Cook for 2.5-3 hours until the meat is very tender. Remove meat and set aside to cool slightly.
Strain the broth and return it to the pot. Slice or shred the meat finely and return to the broth.
Whisk egg yolks into the soured cream until smooth. Ladle 3-4 spoonfuls of hot broth into the cream mixture, whisking constantly to temper. Repeat until the cream mixture is hot.
Pour the tempered cream slowly back into the pot, stirring. Add vinegar and crushed garlic. Heat very gently -- do not boil. Season.

items.symptom: Soup has curdled after adding cream
items.cause: Temperature too high when cream was added
items.fix: Always temper the cream first and keep heat below a simmer once the cream is in the soup.

content.text: Romania, especially in Bucharest. A traditional ciorba (sour soup) served at every Romanian restaurant. Often eaten with hot green chilli peppers and crusty bread. Considered a cure for almost everything.
